scope.inputs: frozen revision-2 development receipts and current preflight.mjs
scope.excluded: prior/runtime holdout bytes, new candidate generation, reruns, and source changes

quick-lru-B1.result: The stateful successor mechanism did compose an improving local state with a targeted move and passed ordinary showcase validation.

width_recovery.interpretation: The full-validation desktop-readability receipt was used to create a recovery candidate from the route-clean state. The recovery widened all secondary-text boxes and reintroduced layout/routing failures; it did not produce an accepted candidate.

p-retry-C1.termination: 55 attempts, 9.987s. The queue exhausted before either protocol ceiling (64 attempts or 20s).

lilconfig-C1.termination: The fixed 64-attempt ceiling was reached at 12.737s, with 7.263s unused time.

implementation_defects_or_omissions.finding: The diagnostic target extractor accepts connection endpoints and obstacle IDs, but not the desktop-readability subject.nodeId or evidence.owner.id.
implementation_defects_or_omissions.evidence: preflight.mjs targetIds reads subject.from, subject.to, evidence.obstacle.id, subject.obstacle.id, and otherRelationship endpoints; the p-retry readability receipt names abort-error only as subject.nodeId/evidence.owner.id.
implementation_defects_or_omissions.effect: No owner-specific geometry proposal was generated for abort-error. The only readability family widened every component with secondary text.

implementation_defects_or_omissions.finding: The readable-secondary proposal is broad and non-monotone with routing.
implementation_defects_or_omissions.evidence: p-retry attempt 27 follows the clean attempt 26 and returns four layout instances after widening all secondary-text boxes.
implementation_defects_or_omissions.effect: The width recovery did run, but it did not preserve the route-clean geometry.

heuristic_and_budget_limits.finding: Search expansion is globally strict-improvement gated.
heuristic_and_budget_limits.evidence: A successor is enqueued only when lessScore(score, bestScore) is true in preflight.mjs.
heuristic_and_budget_limits.effect: Equal-score alternative states and states that temporarily trade one diagnostic class for another are not expanded, even when a later composition could pass.

heuristic_and_budget_limits.finding: Per-state successors are truncated to 16 before the global 64-attempt cap.
heuristic_and_budget_limits.effect: The order of diagnostic instances can starve later implicated nodes/relationships.

heuristic_and_budget_limits.finding: Lilconfig consumed the attempt cap on deep short-segment branches rather than wall-clock time.
heuristic_and_budget_limits.evidence: 64 attempts completed in 12.737s; the best four-error states appear only at attempts 60-63.
heuristic_and_budget_limits.effect: The observed limit is bounded beam coverage, not subprocess latency or a 20s timeout.

not_an_implementation_failure: The full ordinary showcase receipt was used after a successful layout pass: p-retry attempt 26 emitted composition/desktop-readability and directly led to attempt 27 readable-secondary-7.
State reuse is functional: QuickLRU passed with a targeted successor of local-0-down.

conclusion.development_gate: 1 of 3 passed; the required 2 of 3 was not met.
